title: LeadDrive canonical domain event envelope v1
description: CloudEvents 1.0-compatible envelope for canonical LeadDrive domain events. Kafka record keys are defined separately by the architecture.

id.description: Globally stable event UUID, generated once at command commit and preserved during replay.

source.description: Stable URI identifying the owning LeadDrive producer/domain.

type.description: Past-tense, domain-qualified, versioned event type such as finance.fund-deposit-recorded.v1.

time.description: UTC RFC 3339 business occurrence time; not an ordering guarantee.

datacontenttype.description: Payload media type for envelope v1.

dataschema.description: Immutable schema-registry subject and version reference for data.

organizationid.description: Mandatory LeadDrive tenant identifier derived from the authorized transaction context.

aggregateid.description: Opaque aggregate identifier; may be a UUID, CUID, or migrated stable identifier.

aggregateversion.description: Monotonic sequence within one organization/aggregate type/aggregate ID stream.

correlationid.description: Stable identifier joining one end-to-end business operation.

causationid.description: Identifier of the command or event that directly caused this event.

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent value without optional tracestate.

producerversion.description: Immutable build or Git SHA that produced the event.

classification.description: Highest data classification present in the event.

subjectref.description: Optional non-PII reference used for privacy and retention workflows.

data.description: Schema-validated and minimized domain payload. Secrets and unrestricted binary content are forbidden.
